correct: There is no thisUpdate fallback. A CRL carrying no crlNumber or no authorityKeyIdentifier yields no evidence and is refused at load (fail-closed; RFC 5280 requires conforming CAs to include crlNumber). The unit description registered in verification.toml states this correctly.
